Extract a single normalizeLiability(l) helper -> { type, emi, installments, rate, outstanding, completionYear } to prevent silent drift when schema evolves.

SurplusSection.jsx is now ~4030 lines and mixes export logic, projection math, and JSX. Recommend splitting into: (a) src/pages/DataGathering/export/dataGatheringSheet.js, (b) export/cashflowSheet.js, (c) export/financialPlanSheet.js, (d) hooks/useFamilyDerivedData.js.

rca of the issue: Original bug: Data Gathering Excel export scanned only expense_details for loans and ignored family.liabilities, so Deepak Mishra's 2 home_loan entries stored in the liabilities collection were absent from both the LIABILITIES section of the Data Gathering sheet and the Cash Outflows / TOTAL EXPENSES rows of the Financial Plan sheet, yielding 9 rows in the export vs 11 in the UI Expenses tab. Fix (verified across iterations 42 and 43): (i) DG LIABILITIES section now iterates family.liabilities in addition to loan expense_details (SurplusSection.jsx 1205-1233); (ii) Financial Plan Cash Outflows emits a per-liability row with EMI printed until completionYear (1378-1399); (iii) getTotalFamilyExpenses adds annual EMI to total for each year targetYear < completionYear (802-813). All three code paths use the same field-priority chain for schema forward/backward compatibility.
